intro: Our lab is based in the Longwood Medical Campus at Boston Children's Hospital joint with Harvard Medical School in Boston and is part of a vibrant scientific community with strengths in immunology, translational medicine, and collaborative discovery. Please reach out if you are interested in collaborating!
title: Contact
application_intro: We are building an interdisciplinary team of scientists interested in immune specificity, translational immunology, and the mechanisms that connect antigen recognition to human disease. We welcome applicants from different training stages who are curious, collaborative, thoughtful, and excited to bridge mechanistic biology with clinical impact. Please review the information below and reach out by email with materials tailored to your interests and goals.

application_paths.instructions: We are interested in candidates excited about antigen discovery, T cell biology, and translational immunology. Projects may span autoimmunity, infection, cancer, and immune ligand discovery, depending on background and mutual interest. Please email a CV, cover letter describing a description of your research background and why you are interested in our lab, and contact information for references.
Please reach out by email with your program, research interests, and a short note about why you are interested in the lab.
Please email a CV and a short description of your background, goals, and availability.
Please email a CV, your current year and concentration, and a short note describing your interests and availability.
